paragraphs.text: Ayula , Queen Among Bears , is a legendary Bear from an unknown plane introduced in Modern Horizons .

Ayula is a legendary bear. It is said she was born from the oldest red cedar, nursed on the sap of the tallest spruce, and coronated under the mightiest pine. She leaves runic claw marks that ensure her territories are never left defenseless. She has mostly brown fur on her body except for near her head which is a brighter orange. She has a crown of 6 horns atop her head.
